description: Update a project (name, location, status, dates, number, external_refs). A number already used in the org is refused 409; external_refs replaces the whole list.

external_refs.description: The full list of external references (replaces the current one): up to 10 { source (1-40 chars), ref (1-80 chars) }

number.description: New project number, 1-40 letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, unique in the org. A P-<digits> number is refused 400 unless it is the project's current number

name: tascan_update_project
